items.prompt: Gita has 3 times as many shells as Hana. Hana has 4 shells. Build the model and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Hana is the smaller amount, so she gets 1 unit.
Gita has 3 times as many, so she gets 3 units.
One unit is the number of shells Hana has.
items.explanation: Hana is 1 unit, which is 4 shells. Gita is 3 units, which is 3 groups of 4.

items.prompt: A ribbon is 5 times as long as a string. The string is 3 cm long. Build the model and say what one unit is worth.
hints: The string is the shorter length, so it gets 1 unit.
The ribbon is 5 times as long, so it gets 5 units.
One unit is the length of the string.
items.explanation: The string is 1 unit, which is 3 cm. The ribbon is 5 units, which is 5 groups of 3 cm.

items.prompt: Indra has 2 times as many cards as Joko. Joko has 7 cards. Build the model and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Joko has the smaller amount, so he gets 1 unit.
Indra has twice as many, so he gets 2 units.
One unit is the number of cards Joko has.
items.explanation: Joko is 1 unit, which is 7 cards. Indra is 2 units, which is 14 cards.
